cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Nina's keeping her birthday dinner small. You and I can get noodles.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small? She invited the whole choir.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. She's choosing people she sees every week. It isn't a verdict on your friendship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We rehearse together every Tuesday. Read me her message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She wants an uncomplicated evening. That's the kindest accurate sentence. Come have one with me.

mechanism: A uses its old pupil habit of reading criticism for a next step to soften a friend exclusion, offering company instead of the full hurtful message.
confusable: Not denying the exclusion completely: A edits the reason toward a manageable evening while refusing a damaging exact quotation.
comparison: Artistic rejection versus friendship rupture and offered companionship.
